items.q: Cootie and Duke turned like maybe right

ctx.x: She'd say, 'I caught you again, didn't I?' So -- I'm going to back into another Ellington story that young Edward told me. So we were coming out of -- she was to meet me in Paris, and we were coming out of Brussels and we had a great show there, and you know, as you walk out of the side door, the stage door, Cootie and Duke turned like maybe right, and they wound up in a restaurant, and Mercer and Edward and I turned left and wound up in a swinging nightclub with a lot of pretty ladies there, you know?
